rules: The FCVT.W.D instruction uses the floating-point register rs1 as a source operand.
The FCVT.W.D instruction uses the rounding mode frm as a source operand.
The FCVT.W.D instruction writes the converted result to the floating-point register rd.
If the rm field of the FCVT.W.D instruction is 111, the instruction uses the dynamic rounding mode held in frm.
If the rm field of the FCVT.W.D instruction is not 111, the instruction uses the static rounding mode encoded in the rm field.
If the rm field of the FCVT.W.D instruction is 111, the instruction can set the NV flag in the fcsr register.
If the rm field of the FCVT.W.D instruction is 111, the instruction can set the NX flag in the fcsr register.
